title: Accept architecture decision records
decision: Accept ADR-001 to ADR-010 as written in docs/07-adr/OUTPUT.md, including the three the agent approved as routine (ADR-006 webhook with idempotent handling, ADR-007 transactional outbox, ADR-010 identity-free measurement data)
context: The architecture approved in DEC-007 proposed ten decisions; this stage records each with options, rationale and consequences
rationale: Seven records formalize choices the founder already approved; three are reversible engineering choices that protect notification delivery and data separation
